scope: Public normal/default gradient and unit normalization by global vector norm; scalar and vector pointwise division including scalar JAX arrays, reciprocal sign tests, domains, numeric empties, source error branches.
results: Eight supplemental source controls and four existing division regression items pass. Existing division items repeat Python /; they do not establish all four MATLAB division APIs.
native_quirks: Vector/vector source assigns nG=F.nComponents; short right vectors can fail by indexing. Empty unit normal has zero components, while default empty gradient has three empty components.
remaining: Distinct mrdivide, mldivide and ldivide APIs are still missing. Full MATLAB parity and latest main CI remain unresolved.
